description: A model can compact its live session in the core profile, after a parallel tool response is fully paired, and continue when no decision engine is available.
prompt: Read the file and compact the conversation before continuing.

setup_home_files.config.toml:
provider = "vllm"
base_url = "http://127.0.0.1:{port}/v1"
model = "e2e-model"
[tools]
profile = "core"
[typesafe]
enabled = false
